neighbours.label: something old or superseded that lingers toward its end: the older unit kept on as a backup, an old regime or dynasty, an outdated system (Windows XP) still in use (output promotes ' until', ' final', ' dying', ' retired', ' discontinued')
fire: The older telescope will keep observing as a standby until its gyroscopes fail.

The previous generation of aircraft will remain in reserve until the last one is scrapped.
The war sent the old monarchies of the continent tumbling one after another.

The hospital's records still sat on a mainframe from the 1970s that nobody dared switch off.
quiet: The new telescope will begin observing as soon as its mirrors are aligned.
Thousands of cash machines were installed in shops across the country last year.

The next generation of aircraft will enter service once the first one is delivered.
The treaty created several new states on the continent one after another.
The brand-new ferry will start sailing on the route at the beginning of the decade.
By then the infant republic had opened its first schools and could pay its teachers.
The hospital's records were moved onto a system launched this spring that everyone likes.
